description.es: Construcción de APIs RESTful de alto rendimiento en Java (Spring Boot) y C# (.NET Core) con seguridad JWT.
description.en: Building high-performance RESTful APIs in Java (Spring Boot) and C# (.NET Core) with robust JWT security.

es: Microservicios desacoplados con Spring Boot & .NET Core
Autenticación segura basada en tokens JWT y roles
Contenedorización con Docker y Docker Compose
en: Decoupled microservices architecture using Spring Boot & .NET Core
Hardened security with JWT bearer authentication and role-based access control
Interactive API documentation via OpenAPI 3.0 / Swagger UI
Container packaging and orchestration with Docker and Docker Compose
